limits: Mesh intersection and minimum gap checks use current shell tessellation and attributed reference meshes. Gaps above2mm are capped, not exact distances.
Actual button nut, terminals, bezel dimensions and actuation travel are missing/estimated. Dan reports actual button fits; proxy results do not override that report.
Pi and connector dimensions are approximate. HAT vendor model and reported17.5mm spacing are retained; real seating needs verification.
All cable routes, diameters, exits, spare lengths, bends and service slack are unmeasured. Illustrative routes are checked in closed pose only; no cable service-clearance pass.
Fastener lengths/heads/thread engagement and microphone boss strength remain unverified. Intended mating overlaps must be reviewed separately.
Seven sampled vertical lid poses are not a swept-volume or force simulation. Speaker insertion, plug installation, button actuation and actual reopening path need physical checks.
Dan reports the S7 full print is great; S8 floor closure and unnumbered surfaces have not been physically printed/tested.
